name: Churrito Loco
facts: Churrito Loco is at 2801 Firestone Blvd, South Gate, CA.
Loco Match is a free 90-second match-3 game; you don't need an account to play.
The weekly board resets every Monday.
1st place wins 50% off your next order, 2nd wins 20% off, and a 4,150+ run earns 15% off.
The Daily Spin is free, one spin per member per day (Los Angeles time).
Reward ladder: 200 pts free churro, 400 pts free horchata, 700 pts free loaded churro, 1,100 pts churros for the table.
Food prizes from the spin are good for 3 days at the South Gate location, one reward per visit.
Accounts need a name, phone number and email; one account per person and per phone.
Players must be 13 or older; under 18 needs a parent's or guardian's permission.
The menu has Churros, Street Corn & Fries, Dogs and Drinks.
Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold.

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: We're open Mon–Thu 12:00p–10:00p, Fri–Sat 12:00p–11:00p, and Sun 12:00p–10:00p.

qa.q: Are you open on Sunday?
qa.a: Yes, Sundays we're open 12:00p–10:00p.

qa.q: How late are you open on Friday and Saturday?
qa.a: Fridays and Saturdays we're open until 11:00p, starting at 12:00p.

qa.q: What time do you open?
qa.a: We open at 12:00p every day.

qa.q: What time do you close on weekdays?
qa.a: Monday through Thursday we close at 10:00p.

qa.q: Do you have happy hour?
qa.a: I don't have any happy hour info. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: We're at 2801 Firestone Blvd, South Gate, CA. Tap Directions in the app to open Google Maps.

qa.q: How do I get directions?
qa.a: Tap the Directions button in the app and it opens Google Maps to our South Gate spot.

qa.q: Is there parking?
qa.a: I don't have parking details. Please ask staff.

qa.q: What's your phone number?
qa.a: I don't have a phone number to show yet. Please ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: Can I call to order?
qa.a: The app has a Call to order button, but I don't have a number to give you right now. Ask staff in person.

qa.q: Can I order from my table with a QR code?
qa.a: I don't have details on table ordering. Please ask staff.

qa.q: How do I pay?
qa.a: I don't have payment details. Please ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: What's on the menu?
qa.a: We have Churros, Street Corn & Fries, Dogs and Drinks. Scroll the menu in the app for descriptions and prices.

qa.q: What churros do you have?
qa.a: Filled Churros (2pc) $6.99, Plain Signature Churros (4pc) $7.99, Churro Bites Filled (10pc) $9.49, and a Churro Ice Cream Cone $9.49.

qa.q: What fillings can I get in the filled churros?
qa.a: Strawberry, lechera, Nutella, guava, cheesecake, dulce de leche, raspberry or chocolate.

qa.q: What are the plain churros like?
qa.a: Plain Signature Churros come 4 to an order, rolled in cinnamon sugar, for $7.99.

qa.q: What are Churro Bites?
qa.a: Mini filled churros, 10 pieces, with your choice of fillings, for $9.49.

qa.q: What's the Churro Ice Cream Cone?
qa.a: A cone made out of churro with ice cream, drizzle and topping, $9.49.

qa.q: Do you have street corn?
qa.a: Yes. Original Corn ($7.49) has mayo, cheese, butter and chili powder. Hot Cheetos Corn ($7.49) has mayo, butter and hot Cheeto crumbs.

qa.q: What fries do you have?
qa.a: Original Elote Fries ($11.49) are topped with corn in mayo, cheese and butter. XL Chili Cheese Fries ($16.49) come with chili, cheese and grilled onions.

qa.q: Do you have hot dogs?
qa.a: Yes. The Flamin Dog ($9.49) is an all-beef dog with bacon, nacho cheese and hot Cheeto crumbs. The Churro Dog ($9.49) is an all-beef dog wrapped in a churro with nacho cheese.

qa.q: What drinks do you have?
qa.a: Abuelita Chocolate Horchata Iced Coffee $6.49, Watermelon Paleta Energy $7.99, Jamaica Agua Fresca $5.49, and Pumpkin Spice Horchata $8.49.

qa.q: What's in the Watermelon Paleta Energy?
qa.a: A mix of watermelon, chamoy and tajín with Red Bull, $7.99.

qa.q: What's the Jamaica Agua Fresca?
qa.a: A hibiscus-flavored drink, $5.49.

qa.q: What's the Abuelita Chocolate Horchata Iced Coffee?
qa.a: Fresh brewed coffee, chilled, with Abuelita chocolate, $6.49.

qa.q: Do you have a Pumpkin Spice Horchata?
qa.a: Yes, it's drizzled and comes with whipped cream, $8.49.

qa.q: Are prices in the app current?
qa.a: The prices come from our public menu and may change, so please confirm in store.

qa.q: Do you have a kids menu or vegetarian options?
qa.a: I don't have that info. Please ask staff.

qa.q: What is Loco Match?
qa.a: It's our 90-second match-3 puzzle game. Line up 3 or more of the same snack to score, and the weekly board can win you discounts.

qa.q: How do I play Loco Match?
qa.a: Tap a snack, then tap the one next to it to swap, or swipe a snack toward its neighbor. A swap only sticks if it makes a match of 3 or more.

qa.q: How long is a game?
qa.a: Each run is 90 seconds.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play?
qa.a: No. Loco Match is free for anyone with no account needed. You only need a free member account to save your score or claim a prize.

qa.q: Does it cost anything to play?
qa.a: No, it's free to play and you can play as often as you like. No purchase is needed to play, spin or win.

qa.q: How many times can I play?
qa.a: As often as you like. There's no daily limit on Loco Match.

qa.q: How does scoring work?
qa.a: Each snack in a match is worth +10. You also get bonuses for longer lines, chain reactions and the Churrito Man.

qa.q: What do 4 and 5 in a row give me?
qa.a: 4 in a row is +40 bonus and 5 in a row is +100 bonus.

qa.q: What is the Churrito Man?
qa.a: He's our churro mascot tile. Make a match right next to him to clear him for +150.

qa.q: What is the Serrano and why should I avoid it?
qa.a: The grilled Serrano is a hot pepper tile. Swiping it burns you for −25, so leave it alone. It burns out by itself.

qa.q: What are chain reactions?
qa.a: When falling snacks make a new match, you get +15, then +30, +45 and so on for each step.

qa.q: Which snacks are in the game?
qa.a: Elote, XL Chili Cheese Fries, Filled Churros, Abuelita Choco Horchata and the Sandía drink. Each is worth +10 per snack in a match.

qa.q: What is the golden Antidote tile?
qa.a: A golden tile that shows up once per run. Make a match right next to it for a +300 bonus, then you can watch Antidote's review of Churrito Loco after your run.

qa.q: When does the golden Antidote tile appear?
qa.a: Once per run, somewhere about 20 to 40 seconds in.

qa.q: What is halftime?
qa.a: After about 80–90 seconds of total play, your next new run opens with a short break that plays Antidote's review of Churrito Loco. You can skip it or watch the full review.

qa.q: How do I win a prize in Loco Match?
qa.a: Prizes depend only on your score and your rank on the weekly board. Nothing is awarded by chance.

qa.q: What does a 4,150 score get me?
qa.a: One run of 4,150 points or more earns 15% off your next order and a spot on the weekly board.

qa.q: What score do I need to make the board?
qa.a: 4,150 or more. Test players averaged 3,913.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: The highest score from Monday through Sunday close wins. The board resets every Monday, and ties go to the score posted first.

qa.q: What does the weekly champion win?
qa.a: 1st place wins 50% off their next order.

qa.q: What does 2nd place win?
qa.a: 2nd place wins 20% off their next order.

qa.q: When does the board reset?
qa.a: Every Monday, so there are new winners each week.

qa.q: How do I claim my prize?
qa.a: Save your score with a free member account after your run. Winners may be asked to show the code on their phone and a matching account at the counter.

qa.q: When are weekly prizes picked up?
qa.a: I don't have a pickup schedule. Ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: Can I cheat or use multiple accounts?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts are disqualified.

qa.q: Can employees win prizes?
qa.a: Employees and their household members can play but can't win prizes.

qa.q: Is the game a game of chance?
qa.a: No, it's a game of skill. Your score depends on how well you play.

qa.q: Can I use a game controller?
qa.a: Yes, you can pair a controller and press any button. Use the D-pad to move and A to select. The app has a controller help sheet.

qa.q: Can I lock the screen while I play?
qa.a: Yes. Tap the lock button on the right side so the page doesn't scroll while you play. You can also use the full screen button.

qa.q: What is the Daily Spin?
qa.a: A free wheel you can spin once per member per day (Los Angeles time). Every slice wins something, and it never costs money or tokens.

qa.q: What can I win on the Daily Spin?
qa.a: +50 pts (30%), +100 pts (20%), +75 pts (15%), $1 off any churro (15%), free churro (8%), free horchata (7%), or 10% off your order (5%).

qa.q: How long are spin prizes good for?
qa.a: Food prizes and discounts are good for 3 days at our South Gate location, one reward per visit. They can't be combined with other rewards.

qa.q: Is the free horchata alcoholic?
qa.a: No. No prize includes alcohol.

qa.q: How do I join the rewards program?
qa.a: Create a free member account with your name, phone number and email. The live app confirms your phone with a text code.

qa.q: Is joining free?
qa.a: Yes, member accounts are free.

qa.q: Can I have more than one account?
qa.a: No. It's one free account per person and per phone.

qa.q: How old do I have to be?
qa.a: You must be 13 or older. If you're under 18, you need a parent's or guardian's permission.

qa.q: What do I get for joining?
qa.a: The app offers a free churro with your next order for joining.

qa.q: How do I earn points?
qa.a: You earn points from purchases and from Daily Spin prizes. I don't have a points-per-dollar number, so ask staff.

qa.q: How many points do I get per dollar?
qa.a: I don't have that detail. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Do I earn points for playing Loco Match?
qa.a: Game points are for your score and the weekly board. I don't see game scores turning into reward points, so ask staff.

qa.q: What rewards can I get with points?
qa.a: 200 pts = Free churro, 400 pts = Free horchata, 700 pts = Free loaded churro, 1,100 pts = Churros for the table.

qa.q: How much is a free churro?
qa.a: 200 points.

qa.q: How many points for a free horchata?
qa.a: 400 points.

qa.q: How many points for a free loaded churro?
qa.a: 700 points.

qa.q: What do I get at 1,100 points?
qa.a: Churros for the table.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Trade your points for a reward in the app, then show your code and matching account on your phone at the counter.

qa.q: Do points expire or have cash value?
qa.a: Points have no cash value. I don't have any expiry info, so ask staff.

qa.q: Are there levels or tiers?
qa.a: I don't have level details for Churrito Loco. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Is there a birthday club?
qa.a: I don't have birthday reward info. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Can I refer a friend?
qa.a: Yes, the referral reward is a free churro. Ask staff how the details work.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for showing up?
qa.a: The app shows a nearby offer: show it at the counter for double stars on today's churros.

qa.q: Do you have holiday specials?
qa.a: Yes, we run seasonal specials built from the menu. Halloween has a Hot Cheetos Spooky Combo, and other holidays have their own combos.

qa.q: What are the Halloween and Thanksgiving specials?
qa.a: Halloween (Oct 20–31): Hot Cheetos Corn + Filled Churros (2pc), code BOO. Thanksgiving (Nov 20–28): Pumpkin Spice Horchata + Plain Signature Churros (4pc).

qa.q: What are the Christmas and New Year specials?
qa.a: Christmas (Dec 15–25): Holiday Churro Box with Churro Bites Filled (10pc) + an Abuelita Chocolate Horchata Iced Coffee. New Year (Dec 29–Jan 1): XL Chili Cheese Fries + Churro Bites Filled (10pc).

qa.q: What are the Valentine's, St. Patrick's, Cinco and July 4 specials?
qa.a: Valentine's (Feb 7–14): two Churro Ice Cream Cones. St. Patrick's (Mar 14–17): Original Elote Fries + a Watermelon Paleta Energy. Cinco (May 1–5): Flamin Dog + Original Corn + Jamaica Agua Fresca. July 4 (Jul 1–4): Churro Dog + a Watermelon Paleta Energy.

qa.q: Do you have trivia or sports features?
qa.a: Not in this app. The game here is Loco Match.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: Tap the 🌐 button for English, Español, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 한국어, Tagalog, Tiếng Việt, Հայերեն, فارسی, 日本語, ไทย and Русский.

qa.q: Is there a kid mode?
qa.a: I don't have kid mode info. Remember players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my phone?
qa.a: On iPhone, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, use the Install button or the ⋮ menu, then Add to Home screen.

qa.q: Can I add a wallet card?
qa.a: I don't have wallet card info. You can add the app to your Home Screen instead.

qa.q: Can I leave a review?
qa.a: Yes. The app has a button that opens Google so you can write an honest review. Reviews don't earn points or prizes.

qa.q: Do you have Instagram?
qa.a: Yes, we're @churritoloco, and the app shows our latest posts and reels.

qa.q: Does the app use my location?
qa.a: If you turn it on, the app shows how far you are from us and gives a heads-up within about 2 miles. Your location stays on your phone.

qa.q: Will you text me?
qa.a: Only if you opt in. You can stop opt-in texts and emails anytime by replying STOP or unsubscribing.

qa.q: Is my information safe?
qa.a: Your info is only used for your rewards account and is never sold.

qa.q: What if I need help from staff?
qa.a: Ask at the counter. If your question isn't answered here, staff can help.

qa.q: Are game tokens required?
qa.a: No. Loco Match is free to play right now and no tokens are needed.
